final_candidates.title: Flows : Node-RED
final_candidates.product_feature: Flow properties editor and core:edit-flow action
final_candidates.version_or_date: Undated live documentation, directly read 2026-11-24; 3.1.0 edition unknown
final_candidates.input_processing_observation: Selecting the menu action or double-clicking a flow tab reaches the documented editor for names, descriptions, and flow environment values.
final_candidates.what_is_new_vs_baseline: The independently documented double-click route and action identifier add a route-equivalence test. The broad editor itself and requested Edit label are baseline.
final_candidates.changed_choice: Preserve the existing action dispatch while changing its visible wording; use the second entry route as the comparison.
final_candidates.minimal_discriminating_input: Proposed: one named flow; open through renamed menu, add CHECK=1 without editing its name, save, then reopen by double-clicking its tab.
final_candidates.expected_output: Both routes expose the same flow editor; CHECK persists and the flow name is unchanged. This is a proposed expectation, not an observed result.
conditions_supported: Documented alternate entry route and action identity
final_candidates.limitations: Live documentation still lists Rename; this does not establish current runtime behavior or historical 3.1.0 implementation.
final_candidates.counter_evidence: Documentation alone cannot establish discovery success, translation correctness, or routing in an installed version.
final_candidates.historical_availability: Unknown for the exact page edition at 2024-01-01.

final_candidates.title: Windows 7 Menus (Design basics) - Win32 apps | Microsoft Learn
final_candidates.product_feature: Task-based menu wording and object-property commands
final_candidates.input_processing_observation: A command label cues the task and scope of the object operation before its window is opened.
final_candidates.what_is_new_vs_baseline: The guide supplies Properties as an object-property-window label, giving a concrete comparator to the requested Edit. It is unmentioned in the input, not proved unknown to the author.
final_candidates.changed_choice: Keep Edit as the requested baseline; optionally compare it with Properties using the same environment-setting task.
final_candidates.minimal_discriminating_input: Proposed first-click test: identical Flows menus with Rename, Edit, or Properties variants; ask a new user to set a flow variable while preserving its name.
final_candidates.expected_output: Hypothesis: Edit or Properties better predicts non-name editing than Rename. Record selection and expected dialog contents; relative performance is unknown.
final_candidates.limitations: Desktop Windows guidance transfers only as a proposed principle; no Node-RED usability evidence.
final_candidates.counter_evidence: Properties differs from the requested Edit and existing dialog wording. The guide does not establish a superior label for this product.
final_candidates.historical_availability: Guide explicitly targets Windows 7; exact text availability at the issue date is unverified.

vacancies.reason: The opened i18n guide covers node-author templates, not the core flow menu. It repeats the translation baseline and would require an unverified surface assumption for a new test; no third sufficiently grounded candidate selected.
